mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: In the absence of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS stable or falling), 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it triggers a monetary policy response that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) and industrial production slowdown (INDPRO falling), the dual pressure on corporate margins and discount rates drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1700), declining housing starts further reduce consumer spending and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1700, 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases despite declining HOUST, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS rising) combined with declining unemployment (UNRATE falling) indicates a robust labor market that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), further rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases despite rising FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: When INDPRO rises, 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
